amendments.title: Support: Send message hidden behind the iPhone keyboard
amendments.what: Smoke test 2026-09-19 (iPhone 16, Expo Go): with the cursor in 'Your message' the keyboard covers Send. The 2026-09-16 fix made Send reachable by scrolling but never brought it into view.
amendments.fix: ScrollView ref + scrollToEnd when the keyboard shows while the message box has focus (and on focus if the keyboard is already up). Android unproven: emulator soft keyboard was off.

amendments.title: Android: bottom nav rides on top of the keyboard
amendments.what: Pixel 7 (API 34), Support message box: Android resizes the window, so the bottom nav sits above the keys and eats typing room. On the iPhone the keyboard covers it.
amendments.fix: BottomNav returns null on Android while the keyboard is up (keyboardDidShow/Hide). iOS untouched. Header comment names the divergence.

amendments.title: Privacy Notice: no way back when it fails to load (or while loading)
amendments.what: Offline, open the Privacy Notice from sign-in/OTP: 'couldn't be loaded' shows with no ← Back, so a signed-out teacher is stranded. Cause: PrivacyNotice.jsx returns early for the failed AND loading states, before the head that carries onBack. Row expects 'Back still works'. Check the phone's privacy route for the same shape during the phone walk.

amendments.title: Expired OTP: boxes stay live; 'Send a new code' only a link; mid-run Resend to go
amendments.what: Once the 60s code expires, Verify disappears but the six boxes still accept typing and paste — she can fill a code she can never submit. And 'Send a new code', now the only thing on offer, is a small lgl-link inside the quiet line. Founder: when expired, the boxes should not accept input, and 'Send a new code' should be a full-size button in Verify's place (same size as 'Verify & continue →'). Login.jsx's own comment already says 'sending a new code is the only thing on offer'. Check the phone's OTP screen for the same shape. ALSO (founder decision 2026-09-20): REMOVE the mid-run 'Resend' that appears at 0:30 left (otpCanResend / OTP_RESEND_LOCK_MS) — it can invalidate a code she is halfway through typing and saves at most 30s; the full-size 'Send a new code' at expiry is the only resend. Matches the row and Login.jsx's own 'NO Resend while it runs' comment. Check the phone for the same Resend.

amendments.title: First-run wheels: roll continuously; keyboard arrows after on-screen ▲▼
amendments.what: (1) Founder: the first-run wheels should roll CONTINUOUSLY — past the last item back to the first — as My Lessons' Subject/Class wheels already do. RollWheel's loop mode is gated on `peek` ('the base wheel (FirstRun) is untouched'); extend it to first run (subject + class certainly; chapter wheel: founder to confirm, since wrapping hides where the chapter list ends). Phone wheels are ports — same change. (2) Web: ↑↓ keys step the wheel only when the wheel itself has focus; after clicking the on-screen ▲/▼ focus sits on the button and the keyboard arrows do nothing. Keep focus on the wheel after an arrow-button click (or let the buttons forward ↑↓). Also seen on the CLASS wheel (03.24).

amendments.title: Chapter wheel: drop the 'Chapter N:' prefix; larger chapter label (web only)
amendments.what: (1) Each chapter row shows the number in the green chip AND a title reading 'Chapter 4: …' — the number twice. The label is c.chapter_title verbatim (FirstRun.jsx ~742), so the prefix comes from the chapter data; strip a leading 'Chapter N:' for display in this wheel (check whether other surfaces show the same doubling before deciding to strip at the API). (2) The chapter label reads small against 'Choose the chapter to teach' — raise it on WEB. ★ Founder: the size change is WEB ONLY; the phone's chapter-label size is to be reviewed on its own during the phone walk, NOT carried over automatically. The prefix removal (1) is a content fix — decide for the phone during its walk too.

amendments.title: Chapter step: 'Change' wheels for duration/periods far smaller than the settled value
amendments.what: Opening 'Change' on Class duration or Estimated periods shows a RollWheel whose number/label is much smaller than the value displayed in the box after 'Done' — the edit state shrinks the very figure she is choosing. Review the size so the editing wheel reads at least as large as the settled value (the subject/class wheels pass `large`; the duration/periods wheels at FirstRun.jsx ~762/~795 do not). Sits with WALK-A-006 (chapter label size) — review the step's type scale as one. ★ WEB ONLY; the phone's sizes are reviewed on their own in the phone walk, not carried over.

amendments.title: Web: browser Back leaves Meyy from any screen
amendments.what: Pressing the browser Back button on My Lessons (just after first run) took her OUT of Meyy to the page before it (the incognito start page), not to Meyy's previous screen. Cause: the web shell never writes browser history (no pushState/popstate anywhere in web/app — screens and tabs are React state on one URL), so Back always exits the app, from every screen. The row's own rule is kept (Back must never return INTO first run). Founder to decide the shape: e.g. push a history entry for tab switches, an opened lesson, Settings and its subviews, so Back steps within Meyy; replace (not push) across the first-run → shell boundary so Back can never re-enter first run; and at the root, either leave the app or stay. A whole-web change — walk every family's Back afterwards.

amendments.title: Tour offer is lost if she leaves before answering it
amendments.what: After first run, browser Back left Meyy (WALK-A-008); Forward reloaded the app onto My Classes with NO tour offer, and 'Would you like to check your set-up?' popped instead. Cause: the offer is spent the moment it is SHOWN (POST /account/tour-offered sets tour_offered_at), and after a reload `tourSpent` reads that and `tourOfferedThisSession` has reset — so any reload, Back-and-Forward, closed tab or dropped connection between the offer appearing and her answering it removes the tour for good, and the first-run set-up check (meant to follow the tour) fires in its place. Founder decision: spend the offer on an ANSWER (Take the tour / Skip / ✕) rather than on display, or allow one re-offer after a reload. Check the phone for the same (app killed while the offer is up). Walk workaround used: clear tour_offered_at on 9000000002. FURTHER (same walk): after clearing tour_offered_at and reloading, the server was re-stamped at 05:50:30 — the offer was 'made' on reload — yet it was visible on NEITHER surface: the reload lands on My Classes, where the offer renders only while no section is bound (MyPlans !anyBound — never true after first run binds 9A), and it did not appear on My Lessons either. So the offer is spent while not on screen at all. Tour parked on 02 for this web cycle; walked on a second clean cycle.

amendments.title: Year Plan table unreadable (dark) in a fresh incognito window
amendments.what: Desktop Chrome incognito (fresh storage, so theme pref = default 'system'): the Year Plan table appears dark and its figures are only visible when selected — text and background too close. Rest of the screen not reported dark. Suspect a theme mismatch: dark tokens (or the OS dark scheme / color-scheme) reaching the table cells while the page stays light, or a hardcoded colour. Check with macOS in dark vs light appearance and aruvi-theme unset; compare with the tracker's normal window. Founder's Mac appearance: DARK. So with theme 'system' the desktop web half-follows the OS: the table goes dark while the page stays light (CLAUDE.md: the dark theme flip lives in the ≤600px block — desktop was meant to stay light, but something in .yp-* or color-scheme is reaching the table). CONFIRMED: switching the Mac to Light makes the table readable — the defect follows the OS appearance only.

amendments.title: Create sign in: mobile field keeps the old number after Back
amendments.what: OTP screen (create path) → ← Back to Choose → 'Create sign in →' again: the OTP boxes and sent state reset correctly, but the mobile field still holds the number typed before. Row 03.03 expects an empty field. Founder decision 2026-09-20: CLEAR the mobile field whenever the create OTP screen is entered afresh. Check the phone for the same.
